'''Skillet lasagna''' is a lasagne-style casserole that tastes just like real lasagne, but is ready a lot faster.

== Ingredients ==
__NOTOC__
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) lean [[Cookbook:Ground Beef|ground beef]]
* 1 jar (26 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]/740 g) [[Cookbook:Spaghetti Sauce|pasta sauce]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] ({{convert|125|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) shredded [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|green bell pepper]]
* 1 cup (250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]/8.5 oz) [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* ⅓ cup ({{convert|80|ml|USoz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) Italian [[Cookbook:Salad dressing|salad dressing]]
* 10 uncooked lasagne [[Cookbook:Pasta|noodles]], broken into squares
* 1 clove [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]

==Procedure==

=== Preparing the noodles===
# Boil one clove of garlic in a saucepan of water.
# Add noodles and cook until tender.

=== Preparing the Meat===
# Meanwhile, brown the ground beef in heavy skillet. Drain grease.
# Add pasta sauce, water, dressing, and bell pepper. 
# Stir until well combined and bell pepper is tender. 
# Cover and let simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes.
# Drain noodles and add to meat. Stir until well combined. 
# Cover and let stand under low heat for 5 minutes. 
# Add cheese and stir well, then turn off heat and let cool.
